seo.title: The Menu | PRK 101 Carlsbad
seo.description: BBQ-forward plates built for the rooftop and game day at Park 101 in Carlsbad Village — smoked meats, loaded fries, tacos, and more.

hero.heading: The Menu
hero.body: Burgers, wings, tacos, loaded fries, and shareable favorites built for the rooftop, the courtyard, and game day.

intro.heading: MADE TO SHARE. BUILT FOR PARK 101.
intro.body: Park 101’s kitchen is all about laid-back favorites made for sharing — from burgers and wings to tacos, sandwiches, and shareable plates. Grab a few for the table, find a spot in the courtyard or upstairs, and stay awhile.
